llm.summary: This is a markdown-only personal development coaching skill with no hidden execution, credential access, or persistence behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill's capability is coherent with its stated purpose: it guides an agent through a personal-growth audit using Height, Width, and Depth dimensions, with clear situations where it should and should not be used.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to coaching questions, wait points, scoring, and recommended user exercises; no instruction attempts to override system policy or take unrelated actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown files only and metadata reports no executable scripts, install hooks, or static-scan findings.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request filesystem, credential, session, command, network, or account authority; links are references and optional project links.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: There is no artifact-backed persistence, privilege escalation, background worker, memory modification, or automatic state-writing behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is reasonable to install as a coaching and reflection framework. Users should treat it as self-development guidance rather than mental-health, financial, or crisis advice, and should review any optional external links or repository contribution prompts before acting on them.
llm.findings:
[MP3] expected: The flagged phrase 'rewrite mission' appears in a founder coaching exercise about revising a mission statement, not modifying agent memory or stored context.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan found no suspicious patterns, which matches the markdown-only artifact contents.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean with no malicious or suspicious detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
